scope: Resolve ADANIENPP1 and SILGOPP from issuer-specific official exchange/issuer evidence without changing the published IPO dataset.

decisions.reason: Official issuer and NSE evidence identifies IN9423A01048 / ADANIENPP1 as a partly paid-up rights-issue security after first-call conversion. NSE describes the 2026-02-10 event as a further issue, not an initial public offer.

ordinary_security.note: Ordinary listed equity identity remains separate from the partly paid rights security.

official_facts.listed_security_description: Equity Shares of Re. 1/- each (Re. 0.75/- Paid up)

preserved_conflicts: Aggregate public-past-issues observations carried three conflicting offer periods (2024-09-04..2024-09-06, 2025-07-09..2025-07-11, 2026-01-06..2026-01-08) for the same 2026-02-10 security event.
Those aggregate periods are not reused as IPO offer dates; the official rights-issue period is retained separately.

decisions.reason: NSE and issuer evidence explicitly identifies SILGOPP / IN901II01012 as partly paid-up equity shares allotted on a rights basis. The 2026-02-19 event is therefore not a new IPO.

ordinary_security.note: The issuer states that fully paid rights shares convert into the existing ordinary-equity ISIN.

official_facts.listed_security_description: Partly paid-up Equity shares of Rs. 10/- each (Rs. 5/- partly paid up) allotted on Rights basis

preserved_conflicts: The NSE listing circular records allotment date 2026-02-13, while the issuer's later first/final-call notice states the partly paid rights shares were allotted on 2026-02-17.
The prior aggregate past-issues row reused the issuer's 2018 IPO offer period alongside the 2026-02-19 rights-security listing event; it is not treated as a new 2026 IPO.
